name: ai-panel-wears-the-space-theme
description: The open AI panel on a colored space reads the sidebar's glass ink and wash, then the native surround after Native app view turns on in the running app. Reads the ink, the card fill and the native class off the /ai-panel document before and after the toggle, and captures the window both ways. Settings closes with Escape before the second capture so it does not cover the panel.

actions.note: the container widens and the tint push lands

actions.expression: (() => { const r = document.documentElement; const s = getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('atrium-root')); const card = document.querySelector('.aipcard'); return 'ink=' + s.getPropertyValue('--atrium-ink').trim() + ' card=' + getComputedStyle(card).backgroundColor + ' surround=' + getComputedStyle(r).getPropertyValue('--atrium-surround-color').trim() + ' native=' + r.classList.contains('atrium-native-chrome'); })()

actions.note: the first stream in a run can deliver no frames
the window builds and the route answers

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="appearance"]'); if (!b) return 'no-pane'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()
(() => { const t = document.querySelector('.settings-row[data-key="opaqueSurround"] .settings-row-toggle'); if (!t) return 'no-toggle'; t.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: covers either the instant snap or the crossfade branch
close settings so it does not cover the panel

actions.expression: (() => { const r = document.documentElement; const s = getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('atrium-root')); const card = document.querySelector('.aipcard'); return 'ink=' + s.getPropertyValue('--atrium-ink').trim() + ' card=' + getComputedStyle(card).backgroundColor + ' surround=' + getComputedStyle(r).getPropertyValue('--atrium-surround-color').trim() + ' native=' + r.classList.contains('atrium-native-chrome'); })()

assertions.desc: the browser window alone, settings closed
setup: the hotkey opened the panel
